blurb:
Unwind in style with this 6-hour private wine tour along West Kelowna’s scenic Westside Wine Trail. Known for its stunning vineyard landscapes and exceptional wine culture, this region is home to some of the Okanagan Valley’s most iconic and boutique wineries—all just minutes from downtown Kelowna.

Perfect for wine lovers and casual sippers alike, this immersive experience includes visits to five carefully selected wineries, where you'll enjoy tastings and a relaxed lunch break with vineyard views. Travel in comfort with a professional guide and enjoy the luxury of round-trip hotel pickup and drop-off in Kelowna.
